gaps: ICBC: its 2024/25 consolidated financial statements say it has no active operating subsidiary companies. Its investment properties are held through nominee holding companies, so no records were written.
BC Emergency Health Services: already a graph node (bc-emergency-health-services), so it was not duplicated under PHSA. It is listed as a PHSA program on phsa.ca.
Transportation Investment Corporation and British Columbia Railway Company: the BCTFA's only two subsidiaries (MoTT 2026/27 service plan). Both are already graph nodes.
BC Transit: its four numbered-company property subsidiaries (0928624, 0925406, 0922667 and 0915866 BC Ltd.) were left out as non-operating.

BC Hydro: 11 inactive or nominee subsidiaries were left out. Knowledge Network: the inactive Knowledge West Communications Corporation was left out. FII: the non-operating 0939031 B.C. Ltd. was left out.
PHSA: more programs exist than the 12-record cap allows (for example Stroke Services BC, Trauma Services BC, Provincial Language Services, Emergency Care BC, Critical Care BC and Child Health BC).
No founding year was sourced for most PHSA agencies, PlayNow, BC Cannabis Stores or BC Archives.
bcbudget.gov.bc.ca/2026/sp/ directory index returns 403; agency PDFs fetched directly by filename. BCLC corporate site returned Akamai Access Denied.
Not researched: regional health authorities' hospitals, First Nations Health Authority, WorkSafeBC, Destination BC and other Crowns with no subsidiaries appendix.
